fr.recommendations:
• Mark the single driveway entrance with reflective address markers visible from both directions on the road.
• Keep a clear path along at least one side of the main residence for responders to reach the rear of the property.
• Trim vegetation that crowds the sides of the main residence to allow responders to move around the building.
• Cut back dense vegetation along the route between the main residence and the detached structure.
• Keep the parking area clear of stored vehicles or equipment that could block responders from positioning near the structures.
• Mark the detached structure with a visible address or unit identifier if it is not clearly numbered from the access point.
• Post the utility shutoff locations for the solar panel system in a visible location near the main electrical panel or front entry for arriving responders.
• Trim shrubs or trees that overhang or press against the detached structure on sides where responders may need to work.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree clusters near structures to create more open space between the trees and the buildings.
• Remove lower branches from large trees that hang close to rooflines or walls.
• Separate any shrubs or plants growing directly against the structure's exterior walls or foundation.
• Thin scattered trees that connect tree clusters to structures, breaking up continuous pathways of vegetation toward the buildings.
• Keep both access routes clear of overhanging branches and low-growing vegetation that could block emergency vehicles.
• Trim any vegetation along driveways that narrows the travel lane or reduces driver visibility.
• Maintain the open terrain areas by keeping them free of accumulating dead leaves, dry grass, or woody debris.
